image_description: A modern, angular metal bannister and railing system installed on an outdoor concrete staircase. The structure features a sleek, tubular handrail that follows the sharp diagonal incline of the stairs, supported by thin vertical metal balusters. The design is minimalist and industrial, set against a backdrop of grass, trees, and a concrete wall.
